subject: Marketplace resale evidence, consent & signer-path coordination
messages:
From: Elena Novak <elena@cloudcart.io>
To: logan_wright@redwood.com
Cc: marketplace-ops@cloudcart.io
Date: 2027-08-24T09:12:00Z
Subject: Draft marketplace addendum and signer path

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier this week. Attached is our proposed marketplace addendum with the standard cloud-seller pass-through language and a few notes where our legal team expects confirmation from Redwood on:

- Consent for resale (we currently have a clause that requires written consent for certain resellers — want to confirm Redwood's position).
- Indemnity/pass-through carveouts (we flagged a couple of exposures that we think should be explicitly carved out).
- Evidence & invoice ownership (who retains invoice records for audit purposes).

Can you confirm who at Redwood will be authorized to sign order forms and whether Redwood can accept the pass-through allocation we propose? Ive attached the redline (CloudCart_Marketplace_Addendum_annotated.docx) and a short summary.

Wed like to get this wrapped up by the end of next week if possible. Proposed next steps from our side: you review redlines, respond with any alternate language, and we do a final DocuSign push.

Attachments: CloudCart_Marketplace_Addendum_annotated.docx (redline), evidence_summary.pdf (summary)

Thanks,
Elena Novak
Senior Counsel, CloudCart
elena@cloudcart.io
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Elena Novak <elena@cloudcart.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-24T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Draft marketplace addendum and signer path

Elenas — thanks for the addendum and clear summary. Looping in Legal (Marissa), Partner Ops (Karthik) and Marketplace Ops (Irene) to triage.

Quick asks from my side:
- Marissa: can you take the lead on proposed redlines for the consent and indemnity items? If we can provide alternate language this week, CloudCart can push to signatures next week.
- Karthik: can you confirm Redwood's standard signer matrix for marketplace/order forms? We may need to provide an authorized signer list to CloudCart. I attached a draft signer matrix (Redwood_proposed_signer_matrix.xlsx) — please confirm.
- Irene: can you confirm whether our evidence workflow can produce the invoice ownership/traceability CloudCart requests (audit logs, PDF invoice copies) and any timing constraints?

If useful, I can set an internal 30-minute sync Thurs 26 Aug 10:00 CET to align legal + ops, followed by a joint call with CloudCart on Friday. Thoughts?

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Elena Novak <elena@cloudcart.io>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-25T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Draft marketplace addendum and signer path

Thanks, Logan. Ive reviewed CloudCarts redline and attached an annotated version (RW_annotated_addendum.docx) with suggested edits. High-level summary below.

1) Consent for resale
- CloudCart language currently requires "prior written consent" for certain types of resale. Proposed Redwood edit: replace with a narrower "notification-and-opt-out" approach for catalog resellers and preserve "prior written consent" only for large-volume redistribution beyond marketplace storefronts.
- Rationale: keeps marketplace velocity while protecting customer-level exceptions. Suggested clause: "Reseller may list and resell Products via the CloudCart Marketplace provided Redwood is notified in writing; where the Resale involves third-party redistribution beyond the Marketplace, Reseller must obtain prior written consent from Redwood."

2) Indemnity/pass-through carveouts
- We accept most pass-through language but need explicit carveouts for: (a) breaches of Redwood's data processing obligations, and (b) third-party claims arising from Redwood-managed hosting. Ive inserted carveout text in Section 4.

3) Evidence & invoice ownership
- We can produce invoice PDFs and an audit trail export on request but cannot guarantee escrowed custody of reseller invoices on a perpetual basis. Proposed operational path: Redwood retains invoice records for 24 months in our audit logs; for longer retention, CloudCart must request a periodic export or agree to a shared custody model.

4) Signer authority
- Provide us a completed signer matrix; well validate signers against corporate docs. Attached is our redline and a checklist of what we need for signer validation (signed authorization letter, government ID for signers if required by CloudCarts procurement rules).

Next steps:
- If CloudCart agrees in principle to the consent wording and the carveouts above, well produce a final redline for DocuSign.
- If CloudCart needs stricter retention/escrow, well need to scope a support ticket with Ops (Irene) for long-term custody.

Attachments: RW_annotated_addendum.docx (redline), signer_validation_checklist.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Novak <elena@cloudcart.io>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-26T10:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Draft marketplace addendum and signer path

Elena / Team — quick procurement/ops note from Partner side.

- The partner-paper route is fine; our standard practice is: Cloud partner provides an authorized signer matrix + PO routing instructions, Redwood provides a counter-signed MSA/addendum via DocuSign.
- Attached: proposed_signer_matrix.xlsx (Redwoods preferred template). Please populate and return. We need: legal name, registered address, signer name, title, scope of signing authority, and a dated signature block.
- For invoice ownership: Redwood can accept a pass-through allocation in the order form (i.e., Marketplace collects the order; CloudCart is the reseller on the invoice) but we need to confirm whether CloudCart requires Redwood to escrow copies of reseller invoices beyond our standard 24-month retention. If yes, provide the retention term and responsible contact for exports.

If CloudCart can populate the signer matrix today, well prepare the DocuSign packet tomorrow and aim for signatures by early next week.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: Elena Novak <elena@cloudcart.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marketplace-ops@cloudcart.io
Date: 2027-08-29T16:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Draft marketplace addendum and signer path

Logan / Marissa / Karthik / Irene — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear edits. CloudCart is prepared to accept most of Redwoods suggested changes. A few confirmations and items:

- Consent wording: we can accept Marissas narrower "notification-and-opt-out" approach for standard marketplace listings. We would like the prior-written-consent trigger to remain for any reseller activity that includes sublicensing or off-marketplace redistribution.
- Indemnity carveouts: accepted as drafted in your annotated addendum.
- Invoice retention: CloudCart will accept Redwoods 24-month retention for standard cases. For strategic accounts where longer retention is required, CloudCart will request periodic exports. We do not require perpetual escrow.
- Signer matrix: attached is our signed authorization (CloudCart_Signer_Authorization.pdf) and a completed signer matrix populated per Karthiks template. Ive attached both.

Next step from our side: proceed to DocuSign with the final redline. Ive queued a DocuSign envelope (link below) to speed execution. Please confirm who will be the Redwood signing authority on the order form and well route accordingly.

DocuSign (CloudCart envelope): https://docusign.com/embedded/abc123-cloudcart-addendum

Thanks everyone — we can go ahead once Redwood confirms the signer name(s).

Best,
Elena Novak
Senior Counsel, CloudCart
attachments: CloudCart_Signer_Authorization.pdf, CloudCart_Marketplace_Addendum_annotated.docx, completed_signer_matrix.xlsx
